title_zh: 读写障碍的孩子常被误解
title_en: Kids with dyslexia are often misunderstood
problem_zh: 有读写障碍的孩子并不笨，只是认字、拼写特别吃力，却常被当成不用功。如果没人及早发现，他们很容易失去自信，也跟不上课。
problem_en: Children with dyslexia are bright but find reading and spelling very hard, and are often mistaken for lazy. Without early support they lose confidence and fall behind.
fact_zh: 一项汇总全球研究的分析估计，小学生中约 7.1% 有发展性读写障碍，中文这类表意文字和字母文字的比例差不多。
fact_en: A 2022 meta-analysis of studies worldwide estimated that 7.1% of primary school children have developmental dyslexia, with similar rates for logographic scripts like Chinese and for alphabetic scripts.
big_label_zh: 的小学生可能有读写障碍
big_label_en: of primary pupils may have dyslexia
ai_angle_zh: AI 朗读、分段高亮和语音输入可以减轻阅读负担，但筛查和诊断仍要交给专业人员。
ai_angle_en: AI read-aloud, line highlighting and voice input can ease the reading load, though screening and diagnosis still need professionals.
junior_project_zh: 做一个网页小工具，把课文变成大字号、分段高亮、能朗读的版本，请同学试用并收集反馈。
junior_project_en: Build a simple web tool that turns a textbook passage into large-print, highlighted, read-aloud text, then collect feedback from classmates.
source_name: Brain Sciences (Yang et al., systematic review and meta-analysis)

title_zh: 很多方言和小语种快消失了
title_en: Thousands of languages are quietly disappearing
problem_zh: 世界上很多语言只剩老人会说，孩子已经不再学。一种语言消失了，那里的故事、歌谣和知识也会跟着消失。
problem_en: Many languages are now spoken only by elders, and children no longer learn them. When a language disappears, its stories, songs and knowledge go with it.
fact_zh: 联合国教科文组织指出，全世界至少 40% 的语言濒临消失，平均每两周就有一种语言消失。
fact_en: UNESCO says at least 40% of the world's languages are endangered, with one language disappearing every two weeks.
big_label_zh: 的语言濒临消失
big_label_en: of the world's languages are endangered
ai_angle_zh: 语音识别和转写工具可以帮社区更快地记录、整理老人讲的话，但准确性要由当地人把关。
ai_angle_en: Speech recognition and transcription can help communities record and organise elders' speech faster, with local speakers checking accuracy.
junior_project_zh: 征得长辈同意后，录下他们用家乡话说的 50 个日常词和一首童谣，用 AI 转写后做成家乡话小词典网页。
junior_project_en: With permission, record grandparents saying 50 everyday words and a children's rhyme in their home dialect, transcribe them with AI, and publish a small dialect dictionary web page.

title_zh: 在学校被欺负却不敢说
title_en: Bullied students often stay silent
problem_zh: 被嘲笑、被孤立或被推搡的孩子常常不敢告诉大人，学习、睡眠和心情都会受影响。
problem_en: Children who are teased, left out or pushed around often do not tell adults, and their learning, sleep and mood all suffer.
fact_zh: 联合国教科文组织 2024 年指出，全球约三分之一的学生说自己在过去一个月里被欺负过，网络欺凌影响约 10% 的孩子。
fact_en: UNESCO reported in 2024 that about one in three students worldwide say they were bullied in the previous month, and cyberbullying affects about 10% of children.
big_label_zh: 的学生上个月被欺负过
big_label_en: students bullied in the past month
ai_angle_zh: AI 可以帮学校整理匿名问卷和求助信息，让老师更早发现问题，但处理必须由老师和家长来做。
ai_angle_en: AI can help schools sort anonymous surveys and requests for help so teachers notice problems sooner, while teachers and parents handle the response.
junior_project_zh: 在老师指导下做一份匿名的班级友善问卷，用表格和 AI 汇总结果，再设计一套善意提醒海报或一节班会活动。
junior_project_en: With a teacher's guidance, run an anonymous class kindness survey, summarise it with a spreadsheet and AI, and design kindness posters or a class meeting activity.

title_zh: 蚊子传播的登革热
title_en: Dengue fever spread by mosquitoes
problem_zh: 登革热通过蚊子叮咬传播，在热带和亚热带城市很常见。花盆托盘、旧轮胎里的一点积水就能养出蚊子。
problem_en: Dengue spreads through mosquito bites and is common in tropical and subtropical cities. A little standing water in a flowerpot tray or an old tyre is enough to breed mosquitoes.
fact_zh: 世卫组织估计，全世界约一半人口面临登革热风险，每年约有 1 亿到 4 亿人感染。
fact_en: WHO estimates that about half of the world's population is at risk of dengue, with 100 to 400 million infections each year.
big_label_zh: 的世界人口面临登革热风险
big_label_en: of the world is at risk
ai_angle_zh: 图像识别可以帮人认出积水点和蚊子幼虫，再结合天气数据提示哪里最需要清理。
ai_angle_en: Image recognition can help people spot standing water and mosquito larvae, and weather data can show where cleanup matters most.
junior_project_zh: 带着表格在小区里找积水点并拍照，用 AI 帮忙分类，做一张清积水地图交给物业或居委会。
junior_project_en: Survey the neighbourhood for standing water, photograph each spot, sort the photos with AI, and give a cleanup map to the building manager or residents' committee.

title_zh: 抗生素越来越不管用
title_en: Antibiotics are losing their power
problem_zh: 抗生素用得太多或用错，细菌就会变得不怕药，以后普通感染也可能很难治。很多人还以为感冒就要吃抗生素。
problem_en: When antibiotics are overused or misused, bacteria learn to survive them, so even common infections can become hard to treat. Many people still think a cold needs antibiotics.
fact_zh: 世卫组织数据显示，2023 年全球约每 6 例实验室确认的细菌感染中，就有 1 例对抗生素耐药。
fact_en: WHO reports that about 1 in 6 laboratory-confirmed bacterial infections worldwide were resistant to antibiotics in 2023.
big_label_zh: 的细菌感染对抗生素耐药
ai_angle_zh: AI 可以把用药常识讲得更好懂，帮家庭知道哪些情况不需要抗生素，但不能代替医生开药。
ai_angle_en: AI can explain medicine basics in plain words and help families learn when antibiotics are not needed, but it cannot replace a doctor's prescription.
junior_project_zh: 用世卫组织的资料做一个飞书或豆包问答小助手，回答“感冒要不要吃抗生素”这类常见问题，并统计家人答题前后的变化。
junior_project_en: Build a Feishu or Doubao Q&A agent grounded in WHO materials that answers questions like 'Do colds need antibiotics?', and measure how family members' answers change after using it.

title_zh: 中学生睡不够觉
title_en: Teenagers are not getting enough sleep
problem_zh: 作业、手机和早起上学挤走了睡眠。睡不够会让人白天犯困、心情变差、记不住东西。
problem_en: Homework, phones and early school starts squeeze out sleep. Too little sleep leaves teens drowsy, moody and forgetful.
fact_zh: 美国疾控中心 2023 年调查发现，只有 23% 的美国高中生在上学日晚上能睡够 8 小时。
fact_en: A 2023 US CDC survey found that only 23% of US high school students got at least 8 hours of sleep on an average school night.
big_label_zh: 的高中生上学日能睡够8小时
ai_angle_zh: AI 可以帮学生分析自己的作息记录，找出最影响睡眠的习惯，并给出温和可行的调整建议。
ai_angle_en: AI can help students analyse their own sleep logs, find the habits that hurt sleep most, and suggest gentle, realistic changes.
junior_project_zh: 全班匿名记录两周的入睡时间和睡前用手机的时间，用表格和 AI 画图分析，提出一条大家愿意试的小改变。
junior_project_en: Have the class anonymously log bedtimes and evening phone use for two weeks, chart the data with a spreadsheet and AI, and propose one small change everyone is willing to try.
source_name: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (YRBS 2013-2023 report)

title_zh: 越来越热的夏天伤身体
title_en: Hotter summers are harming people's health
problem_zh: 热浪越来越常见，老人、在户外干活的人和小孩最容易中暑，很多人并不知道高温有多危险。
problem_en: Heatwaves are becoming more common, and older people, outdoor workers and young children are most at risk of heatstroke. Many people underestimate the danger.
fact_zh: 世卫组织援引研究称，2000 到 2019 年间，全球每年约有 48.9 万人死于与高温有关的原因，其中 45% 在亚洲。
fact_en: WHO cites studies estimating about 489,000 heat-related deaths each year between 2000 and 2019, with 45% of them in Asia.
big_label_zh: 人每年死于高温相关原因
ai_angle_zh: AI 可以把天气预报变成给老人和学生的具体防暑提醒，也能帮社区找出最需要阴凉和降温点的地方。
ai_angle_en: AI can turn forecasts into specific heat tips for older people and students, and help communities find where shade and cooling spots are most needed.
junior_project_zh: 用温度计测量校园不同位置的地面温度，做一张校园热点地图，再用 AI 生成防暑提醒发给同学。
junior_project_en: Measure ground temperatures around the school with a thermometer, make a campus hot-spot map, and use AI to write heat-safety tips for classmates.

title_zh: 塑料垃圾很少被回收
title_en: Most plastic waste is never recycled
problem_zh: 外卖盒、饮料瓶和包装袋用几分钟就被扔掉，大部分最后被填埋、烧掉或流进河海，伤害动物和环境。
problem_en: Takeaway boxes, bottles and wrappers are used for minutes and thrown away, and most end up buried, burned or in rivers and seas, harming wildlife.
fact_zh: 经合组织报告显示，2019 年全球产生了 3.53 亿吨塑料垃圾，最终只有 9% 被回收。
fact_en: The OECD reports that the world produced 353 million tonnes of plastic waste in 2019, and only 9% was ultimately recycled.
big_label_zh: 的塑料垃圾被回收
ai_angle_zh: 图像识别可以帮人分清哪种塑料能回收，也能帮学校统计垃圾种类，找出最该减少的一次性用品。
ai_angle_en: Image recognition can help people tell which plastics are recyclable and help schools track waste types to find the single-use items worth cutting first.
junior_project_zh: 在老师带领下连续一周给班级的塑料垃圾拍照，用 AI 识别分类并统计，提出一个减少一次性塑料的班级计划。
junior_project_en: With a teacher, photograph the class's plastic waste for a week, classify and count it with AI, and propose a class plan to cut single-use plastic.

title_zh: 洪水来了却没收到预警
title_en: Floods arrive before the warnings do
problem_zh: 暴雨和洪水来得越来越急。如果能提前几个小时收到预警，很多人就能及时躲开，但不少地方还没有好用的预警系统。
problem_en: Heavy rain and floods are arriving faster. A few hours of warning lets people get to safety, but many places still lack good warning systems.
fact_zh: 世界气象组织指出，全球只有大约一半的国家报告拥有足够的多灾种早期预警系统。
fact_en: The World Meteorological Organization says only half of the countries worldwide report having adequate multi-hazard early warning systems.
big_label_zh: 的国家有足够的灾害预警
big_label_en: of countries have adequate early warnings
ai_angle_zh: AI 天气模型可以更快地预测暴雨，再把预警改写成当地人一看就懂的简短提醒。
ai_angle_en: AI weather models can predict heavy rain faster, and AI can rewrite warnings into short messages local people understand at a glance.
junior_project_zh: 调查学校和小区附近容易积水的路段，结合天气预报做一个暴雨提醒小程序原型，告诉大家哪条路要绕开。
junior_project_en: Map roads near school and home that flood easily, and combine them with forecasts in a prototype rain-alert app that tells people which routes to avoid.

title_zh: 用手语的人常常沟通难
title_en: Deaf signers often struggle to be understood
problem_zh: 很多聋人用手语交流，但医院、车站和学校里很少有人会手语，看病、办事、上课都不方便。
problem_en: Many deaf people communicate in sign language, but few people in hospitals, stations or schools can sign, which makes daily life hard.
fact_zh: 据世界聋人联合会统计，全世界有超过 7000 万聋人，他们使用 300 多种不同的手语。
fact_en: According to the World Federation of the Deaf, there are more than 70 million deaf people worldwide, using more than 300 different sign languages.
big_label_zh: 聋人使用300多种手语
ai_angle_zh: AI 可以辅助识别和学习常用手语词汇，但真正的手语翻译离不开聋人社区的参与。
ai_angle_en: AI can help recognise and teach common signs, but real sign language translation needs deaf community involvement.
junior_project_zh: 和聋人老师或聋人社团合作，做一个校园常用手语视频小词典网页，再加一个简单的练习小测验。
junior_project_en: Partner with a deaf teacher or club to build a video dictionary web page of common school signs, plus a simple practice quiz.
source_name: United Nations (International Day of Sign Languages)

title_zh: 新来的家庭看不懂通知
title_en: New families cannot understand school notices
problem_zh: 搬到新国家的家庭，常常看不懂学校通知、医院单据和办事流程，孩子只好给爸妈当小翻译。
problem_en: Families who move to a new country often cannot read school notices, medical forms or official procedures, so children end up translating for their parents.
fact_zh: 联合国统计，2024 年全球约有 3.04 亿国际移民，比 1990 年几乎翻了一倍。
fact_en: The UN estimates there were 304 million international migrants in 2024, nearly double the number in 1990.
big_label_zh: 人生活在出生国以外
big_label_en: people live outside their birth country
ai_angle_zh: AI 翻译可以把通知变成家长的母语和更简单的说法，但重要信息仍要请懂两种语言的人核对。
ai_angle_en: AI translation can turn notices into parents' home languages and plainer wording, though important details should be checked by a bilingual person.
junior_project_zh: 做一个飞书或豆包小助手，把学校通知改写成简单中文和另一种语言，请会这门语言的老师检查准确性。
junior_project_en: Build a Feishu or Doubao agent that rewrites school notices in simple Chinese and one other language, and have a teacher who speaks it check the accuracy.
source_name: United Nations (UN DESA International Migrant Stock 2024)

title_zh: 很多地方缺水
title_en: Many places are running short of water
problem_zh: 气候变化和人口增长让很多地方用水紧张，缺水时最先受苦的是农民、孩子和贫困家庭。
problem_en: Climate change and population growth are straining water supplies, and farmers, children and poor families suffer first when water runs short.
fact_zh: 世卫组织指出，2021 年全球有超过 20 亿人生活在缺水压力大的国家。
fact_en: WHO notes that in 2021 over 2 billion people lived in water-stressed countries.
big_label_zh: 人生活在缺水国家
ai_angle_zh: AI 可以分析用水数据，发现漏水和浪费，也能帮农田按需浇水。
ai_angle_en: AI can analyse water-use data to spot leaks and waste, and help farms water crops only when needed.
junior_project_zh: 记录家里一周的水表读数和用水习惯，用 AI 帮忙分析，发起一次家庭节水挑战并比较前后的变化。
junior_project_en: Log the home water meter and water habits for a week, analyse them with AI, then run a family water-saving challenge and compare before and after.

title_zh: 很多人感到孤独
title_en: Loneliness touches one in six people
problem_zh: 独居老人、刚转学的学生都可能长期感到孤独。孤独不只是心情不好，还会影响身体健康。
problem_en: Older people living alone and students who just changed schools can feel lonely for a long time. Loneliness is not just a bad mood; it harms physical health too.
fact_zh: 世卫组织社会联系委员会 2025 年报告显示，全球每 6 个人中就有 1 个受孤独影响，13 到 29 岁的人中有 17% 到 21% 感到孤独。
fact_en: The WHO Commission on Social Connection reported in 2025 that 1 in 6 people worldwide is affected by loneliness, and 17-21% of people aged 13-29 feel lonely.
big_label_zh: 的人受孤独困扰
ai_angle_zh: AI 可以帮社区把兴趣相同的人和活动配对，提醒大家常联系，但不能代替真人陪伴。
ai_angle_en: AI can match people with shared interests to local activities and remind them to keep in touch, but it cannot replace real human company.
junior_project_zh: 为小区老人做一个活动信息小助手，每周整理附近的免费活动，同学们再定期打电话或上门陪老人聊天。
junior_project_en: Build a small helper that lists free local activities each week for older neighbours, and organise classmates to call or visit them regularly for a chat.

title_zh: 流浪狗和狂犬病风险
title_en: Stray dogs and the risk of rabies
problem_zh: 流浪动物缺少照顾和疫苗，孩子被咬伤、抓伤的风险更高，很多人也不知道被咬后该怎么处理。
problem_en: Stray animals often go unvaccinated and uncared for, putting children at higher risk of bites and scratches, and many people do not know what to do after a bite.
fact_zh: 世卫组织指出，99% 的人类狂犬病是被狗咬伤或抓伤引起的，死者中约 40% 是 15 岁以下的孩子。
fact_en: WHO says dog bites and scratches cause 99% of human rabies cases, and about 40% of rabies deaths are children under 15.
big_label_zh: 狂犬病死者是15岁以下孩子
big_label_en: of rabies deaths are children under 15
ai_angle_zh: 图像识别可以帮志愿者记录和区分社区里的流浪动物，方便安排疫苗、绝育和领养。
ai_angle_en: Image recognition can help volunteers log and tell apart local stray animals, making vaccination, neutering and adoption easier to organise.
junior_project_zh: 和动物保护志愿者合作，远距离给小区流浪猫狗拍照建档，用 AI 辅助识别，做一张照护地图和一页“被咬后怎么办”的提示。
junior_project_en: With animal-welfare volunteers, photograph neighbourhood strays from a safe distance, use AI to help identify them, and make a care map plus a one-page 'what to do after a bite' guide.

title_zh: 超重肥胖的孩子越来越多
title_en: More children are living with obesity
problem_zh: 含糖饮料、零食广告和久坐不动，让越来越多孩子超重，长大后更容易得糖尿病和心脏病。
problem_en: Sugary drinks, junk food ads and sitting too much are making more children overweight, raising their risk of diabetes and heart disease later.
fact_zh: 联合国儿童基金会 2025 年报告显示，全球 5 到 19 岁的孩子中每 10 个就有 1 个肥胖，约 1.88 亿人，肥胖第一次超过体重过轻。
fact_en: UNICEF reported in 2025 that 1 in 10 children aged 5-19 worldwide, about 188 million, live with obesity, and obesity has overtaken underweight for the first time.
big_label_zh: 学龄孩子肥胖
ai_angle_zh: AI 可以帮人看懂食品标签、估算含糖量，也能帮家庭规划更健康又不贵的饭菜。
ai_angle_en: AI can help people read food labels and estimate sugar content, and help families plan healthier, affordable meals.
junior_project_zh: 拍下学校附近常见饮料和零食的营养标签，用 AI 读出含糖量并换算成方糖块数，做成展板给同学看。
junior_project_en: Photograph nutrition labels of popular drinks and snacks near school, use AI to read the sugar content and convert it to sugar cubes, and make a display board.

title_zh: 小农户缺少种地指导
title_en: Small farmers lack good farming advice
problem_zh: 世界上大多数农场都很小，农户往往找不到农技员，遇到天气变化、病害和价格波动只能凭经验。
problem_en: Most farms in the world are small, and their farmers often cannot reach an expert, so they face weather shifts, plant diseases and price swings on guesswork alone.
fact_zh: 联合国粮农组织 2021 年研究显示，全世界每 6 个农场中有 5 个不到 2 公顷，这些小农场生产了约 35% 的粮食。
fact_en: FAO research from 2021 found that five of every six farms in the world are smaller than two hectares, and they produce roughly 35% of the world's food.
big_label_zh: 的农场面积不到2公顷
ai_angle_zh: 能用方言语音提问的 AI 助手可以把天气和种植建议讲给农户听，但建议要请农技专家把关。
ai_angle_en: A voice AI assistant that understands local dialects could share weather and planting advice with farmers, with agricultural experts checking the answers.
junior_project_zh: 采访一位种地或种菜的亲戚，整理他最常遇到的 10 个问题，做一个豆包或飞书问答助手，并请农技人员检查答案。
junior_project_en: Interview a relative who farms or grows vegetables, list their 10 most common questions, build a Doubao or Feishu Q&A agent, and have an agricultural adviser check the answers.
source_name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

title_zh: 蜜蜂等传粉昆虫受到威胁
title_en: Bees and other pollinators are under threat
problem_zh: 蜜蜂、蝴蝶等昆虫帮植物传粉，但栖息地减少、农药和气候变化正在威胁它们，水果和蔬菜的收成也会受影响。
problem_en: Bees, butterflies and other insects pollinate plants, but habitat loss, pesticides and climate change threaten them, putting fruit and vegetable harvests at risk.
fact_zh: 联合国粮农组织指出，全世界超过四分之三的粮食作物至少部分依靠昆虫等动物传粉。
fact_en: FAO says more than three-quarters of the world's food crops rely at least in part on pollination by insects and other animals.
big_label_zh: 的粮食作物依靠动物传粉
big_label_en: of food crops rely on pollinators
ai_angle_zh: 拍照识别昆虫的 AI 可以帮普通人记录传粉昆虫，让科学家了解它们的分布和变化。
ai_angle_en: Photo-based insect identification lets ordinary people record pollinators, helping scientists track where they live and how numbers change.
junior_project_zh: 在校园花坛每周做一次昆虫观察，用识图 AI 记录种类和数量，再种一小块蜜蜂喜欢的花，比较前后变化。
junior_project_en: Do a weekly insect count in a school flower bed using an identification app, plant a small bee-friendly patch, and compare counts before and after.
source_name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

title_zh: 暑假溺水夺走孩子生命
title_en: Drowning takes many children's lives
problem_zh: 暑假在河边、水塘玩水的孩子最容易出事。溺水往往几十秒就发生，而且很安静，旁边的人不一定能发现。
problem_en: Children playing near rivers and ponds in summer are most at risk. Drowning can happen in seconds and silently, so people nearby may not notice.
fact_zh: 世卫组织数据显示，全球每年约有 30 万人溺水死亡，溺水是 5 到 14 岁儿童的第三大死因。
fact_en: WHO reports around 300,000 drowning deaths worldwide each year, and drowning is the third leading cause of death for children aged 5-14.
big_label_zh: 5到14岁儿童的死因排名
ai_angle_zh: AI 可以帮社区分析哪些水域最危险、什么时候最容易出事，把防溺水提醒送到最需要的地方。
ai_angle_en: AI can help communities work out which waters are most dangerous and when accidents peak, so safety messages reach the right places.
junior_project_zh: 在大人陪同下，调查家附近的河塘有没有警示牌和救生设施，用 AI 整理成防溺水风险地图交给社区。
junior_project_en: With an adult, check nearby rivers and ponds for warning signs and rescue equipment, and use AI to turn the findings into a drowning-risk map for the community.

title_zh: 骗子盯上老人的钱
title_en: Scammers target older people's savings
problem_zh: 冒充客服、投资理财、网上交友等骗局专挑老人下手，很多老人被骗后不好意思告诉家人。
problem_en: Fake customer service, investment and online romance scams often target older people, and many victims feel too embarrassed to tell their families.
fact_zh: 美国联邦调查局数据显示，2024 年 60 岁以上人群报告的网络诈骗损失达 48.85 亿美元，投诉数量比前一年增加 46%。
fact_en: FBI data show that people over 60 reported $4.885 billion in internet crime losses in 2024, with complaints up 46% from the year before.
big_label_zh: 60岁以上老人一年被骗
ai_angle_zh: AI 可以识别可疑短信和来电里的常见骗术话术，及时提醒老人和家人。
ai_angle_en: AI can flag common scam wording in suspicious texts and calls and alert older people and their families in time.
junior_project_zh: 收集公开的反诈案例，做一个豆包或飞书小助手，老人把可疑短信转给它就能看到大白话的风险提示，再教爷爷奶奶使用。
junior_project_en: Using public anti-fraud cases, build a Doubao or Feishu agent that gives a plain-language risk warning when an older person forwards a suspicious message, then teach grandparents to use it.
source_name: FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (2024 Internet Crime Report)

title_zh: AI 假视频真假难辨
title_en: Deepfakes are hard to tell from real
problem_zh: 用 AI 做的假视频、假声音越来越像真的，被用来骗钱、造谣或捉弄人，孩子和老人都容易上当。
problem_en: AI-made fake videos and voices look more real every year and are used to scam, spread rumours or mock people, and children and older people are easily fooled.
fact_zh: 英国通信管理局 2024 年调查发现，8 到 15 岁的孩子中有一半说自己在半年内至少见过一次深度伪造内容。
fact_en: A 2024 Ofcom survey found that 50% of children aged 8-15 in Britain believed they had seen at least one deepfake in the previous six months.
big_label_zh: 的8到15岁孩子见过假视频
ai_angle_zh: 检测工具和内容来源标记可以帮忙识别 AI 伪造，但最重要的还是养成多方核实的习惯。
ai_angle_en: Detection tools and content provenance labels can help spot AI fakes, but the most important habit is checking multiple sources.
junior_project_zh: 收集公开的真实和 AI 生成图片，做一个“找破绽”小测验网页，总结五条识别技巧，在班上测试大家的识别率。
junior_project_en: Collect public real and AI-generated images, build a 'spot the fake' quiz web page with five detection tips, and measure how well classmates do.
